remarks: DREAM LOCATION! FIRST time on the market .This condo has all the amenities of a house. A unique 5 unit complex. This is an end unit with access to a side yard and a large patio and deck. Perfect for out door dining .There are plenty of windows for a light filled space. There are multiple closet for storage and an extra storage in the attached 1 car garage. There are 2 bedrooms and 2.5 baths with the primary bedroom on the upper level. There is a large kitchen with granite counter tops adjacent to the living room/dining room with a gas fireplace. French doors lead to the outdoor space. The lower level has a home office and the laundry is located there. Make your appointment today!
